title: Account activity triage
content: For unusual logins, verify the account owner, source context, MFA events, device posture, and approved travel. Correlate with identity-provider audit logs. Do not disable accounts solely from a heuristic finding.

title: Network anomaly triage
content: Validate network anomalies against approved scanners, change windows, asset ownership, and established traffic baselines. Preserve relevant logs and escalate through the organization's incident process.

title: Incident investigation basics
content: Record timestamps, evidence sources, scope, and uncertainty. Prefer read-only validation and approved procedures. Keep containment or destructive actions under explicit human authorization.

title: CVE-2021-44228 · Apache Log4j2
content: A JNDI lookup handling flaw can allow remote code execution in affected Log4j2 deployments. Recommended action: Inventory affected applications and libraries; apply fixed versions and follow CISA and vendor guidance.
source: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog / advisory

title: CVE-2021-26855 · Microsoft Exchange Server
content: A server-side request forgery vulnerability in Exchange Server was exploited as part of the ProxyLogon attack chain. Recommended action: Apply Microsoft security updates and review Exchange systems for signs of compromise.
source: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog / advisory

title: CVE-2023-34362 · Progress Software MOVEit Transfer
content: An SQL injection vulnerability in MOVEit Transfer was exploited to access affected transfer databases. Recommended action: Apply vendor updates and follow CISA/FBI MOVEit campaign guidance for affected deployments.
source: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog / advisory

title: CVE-2023-22515 · Atlassian Confluence Data Center and Server
content: A broken access control issue enabled unauthorized administrator-account creation in affected Confluence instances. Recommended action: Apply Atlassian updates and inspect instances for unauthorized accounts and compromise indicators.
source: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog / advisory

title: CVE-2023-4966 · Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway
content: A buffer overflow in certain NetScaler configurations can disclose sensitive information. Recommended action: Update affected appliances and follow CISA guidance to review and terminate persistent sessions as directed by the vendor.
source: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog / advisory

title: CVE-2024-3400 · Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS GlobalProtect
content: An arbitrary file creation issue can lead to command injection on affected PAN-OS configurations with GlobalProtect enabled. Recommended action: Check affected versions and configuration, then apply Palo Alto Networks guidance and mitigations.
source: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog / advisory

title: CVE-2024-21887 · Ivanti Connect Secure and Policy Secure
content: A command injection vulnerability in web components of affected Ivanti appliances was exploited in combination with other issues. Recommended action: Apply Ivanti updates and follow CISA guidance to investigate affected appliances.
source: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog / advisory

title: CVE-2024-1709 · ConnectWise ScreenConnect
content: An authentication bypass in ScreenConnect can allow an actor with network access to the management interface to create an administrator account. Recommended action: Update ScreenConnect to the vendor-fixed release and review systems for unauthorized access.
source: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog / advisory

title: CVE-2024-23897 · Jenkins Jenkins CLI
content: A path traversal issue in the Jenkins command-line interface can expose local files and may lead to further compromise. Recommended action: Update Jenkins and review exposed controllers using current vendor guidance.
source: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog / advisory

title: CVE-2024-0012 · Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS management interface
content: An authentication bypass vulnerability affects the web-based management interface in certain PAN-OS products. Recommended action: Restrict management-interface exposure and apply Palo Alto Networks security updates.
source: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog / advisory
